item.mod-stella-spells.spark_shot.effect: Hits the mob for 3 magic damage and sets it on fire for 2 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.frostbind.effect: Chills the mob with Slowness II for 4 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.gale_step.effect: Launches you forward on a gust, then lets you drift down with Slow Falling for 2 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.stoneguard.effect: Hardens your skin with Resistance I for 4 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.static_lash.effec: Shocks the mob for 3 damage, then arcs 3 damage to up to two more hostiles within 4 blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.briar_snare.effec: Roots the mob in thorns with Slowness IV for 4 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.tidal_push.effect: Knocks the mob away from you with a wave.
item.mod-stella-spells.slimebound.effect: Grants Jump Boost II and Slow Falling for 8 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.chainstorm.effect: Strikes the mob for 7 damage, then chains 4 damage through up to two more hostiles within 4 blocks of each other.
item.mod-stella-spells.riftwalk.effect: Teleports you to the first safe spot in front of you, never into walls, water or mobs.
item.mod-stella-spells.phoenix_mantle.ef: Grants Fire Resistance for 30 seconds and heals you for 2 hearts.
item.mod-stella-spells.life_bloom.effect: Heals you for 4 hearts and grants Regeneration I for 5 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.void_well.effect: Pulls every hostile within 5 blocks of the spot toward it and slows them with Slowness II for 3 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.wardens_roar.effe: Deals 6 damage to every hostile within 5 blocks of you and throws them back.
item.mod-stella-spells.aegis_of_the_deep: Grants Absorption II and Resistance I for 4 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.wither_seal.effec: Seals the mob with Wither II for 5 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.time_lock.effect: Slows every hostile within 5 blocks of the spot with Slowness II for 5 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.dragonfall.effect: Calls down a dragon strike for 10 magic damage to every hostile within 3 blocks of the spot.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.target.hosti: Target: the hostile mob you look at, up to 16 blocks away
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.target.block: Target: the block you look at, up to 16 blocks away
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.target.safe_: Target: the first safe spot up to 12 blocks ahead
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.use.hostile: Use: hold it and right-click while aiming at the mob
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.use.block: Use: hold it and right-click while aiming at the ground
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.use.safe_tel: Use: hold it, face where you want to go, and right-click
